architecture.caption: Overall MLCN architecture. Solid blocks show audited components; the dashed Gemini block is proposed. This is an architectural diagram, not a measured network topology.

pipeline.caption: Five-module processing pipeline and typed handoffs. The pipeline orchestrator connects existing module APIs and retains the genuine combined result.

packet_flow.caption: Packet-to-flow transformation, completion and classification eligibility. Discard and completion rules are architectural conditions, not experimental detection rates.

bidirectional.caption: Bidirectional key construction and orientation. Canonical endpoint ordering and forward-direction anchoring serve different purposes.

features.caption: Feature-engineering workflow under the current 24-feature contract. Timing features use microseconds; rates use seconds.

inference.caption: XGBoost loading and inference. Confidence is the maximum model probability and is not a calibrated probability of a real intrusion.

training.caption: Recorded training/evaluation methodology and audit replay. Early notebook outputs are inconsistent; the saved test artifacts and regenerated inference are independently checked.

generator.caption: Generator/receiver interaction and evidence paths. Profile reference medians do not bypass capture or enter the detector as synthetic feature vectors.

gemini.caption: Proposed Gemini explanation architecture. Dashed blocks are unimplemented design elements; only genuine evidence is eligible for explanation.

distribution.caption: Verified class distribution in models/xgboost_test_predictions.csv, n = 251,812. Bar heights use a logarithmic count axis.

performance.caption: Per-class precision, recall and F1 reconstructed from saved offline labels. Brute Force precision is substantially below the other classes.

confusion.caption: Verified offline confusion matrix. Cell annotations are exact counts; colour represents log10(count + 1). Rows are actual and columns predicted.

roc.caption: One-versus-rest ROC curves regenerated from the saved booster and test features using XGBoost 2.1.4. These are offline ranking results.

pr.caption: One-versus-rest PR curves from regenerated probabilities. The black point shows the separate Brute Force multiclass argmax operating point.

live_counts.caption: Saved laboratory opening-flow counts, reconciled using consecutive JSONL blocks and the saved report’s profile totals. Matching is relative to the selected profile.

confusion.title: Exact confusion matrix (actual rows, predicted columns)

xai_contract.title: Proposed Gemini evidence and response contract
